text:
alice: kicking off tenant_id type migration in the 02:00–03:00 PT change window. Posting plan + holdpoints. TL;DR: staged backfill, PK swap, feature-flag flip, rollback criteria: sustained p95 > 1s for >10m OR any primary lock >30s.

deploy-bot: scheduled migration job 1722468013 started on canary nodes (canary-03).

ben: canary backfill initial run looks good — 10k rows, no immediate lock spikes.

carla: i'll pin billing-service to v3.2.1 for the window and push release note blurb.

dylan: watching via lockwatch and p95-latency dashboards. if wait_time > 2s for >5% queries during a 5m window we hit a holdpoint.

deploy-bot: canary backfill progress: 4/10 shards completed, avg per-shard time 12s, projected finish ~18m at current rate.

eva: feature flag tenant_swap set to 1% (canary) — will bump after 15m checkpoint if stable.

alice: plan: if canary passes 15m checkpoint, proceed to rolling apply with rate cap 200 rows/s and checkpoint every 5m.

ben: current p95 ~60ms, but saw an isolated 4.2s spike at ~1722468050 — correlating with an index rebuild on replica?

carla: that spike looks like replica catch-up + async index rebuild. do we pause and evaluate?

dylan: holdpoints enumerated: 1) pause if sustained p95 > 1s for >10m; 2) abort if any lock duration >30s on primary; 3) escape hatch = pin services back to previous schema versions and run rollback script.

alice: deploy-bot, please prepare to pause at next safe boundary if condition 2 triggers.

deploy-bot: acknowledged — installing watches: lockwatch, p95-latency. alerts configured to notify #incidents and @oncall.

deploy-bot: runbook: https://intra/redwood/runbooks/migrations#tenantid-swap (ops checklist + rollback steps).

eva: release notes draft: 'DB: tenant_id type migration — rolling canary, planned rollback restores tenant_id_v1 column and cleans temp artifacts. See runbook link.'

ben: canary backfill hit a transient DB lock — single shard locked for 41s at 1722468078. snapshot log: ```ERROR: could not obtain lock on relation tenant_123_shard_04; pid=4321 wait=41s```

alice: that's over our 30s threshold. initiate rollback now. carla, start rollback playbook and pin services.

carla: pinning billing-service -> v3.1.9 and auth -> v2.9.4. kicking off rollback job id rb-1722468013-1.

deploy-bot: rollback job rb-1722468013-1 started. rolling back DB change on canary shard 04. ETA ~4m. monitoring progress.

dylan: for the postmortem: consider lowering per-shard batch size, increase checkpoint frequency, and add pre-check for replica index rebuilds during window.

eva: updating release notes: 'ABORTED: tenant_id migration during 02:00 window due to lock >30s on primary. Next steps: reduce batch size, re-run canary with improved checks.'

ben: rollback completed on shard 04 and canary nodes. p95 returned to ~120ms. will watch for 10m.

alice: thank you — good catch and quick rollback. we'll schedule a follow-up retro + new canary plan. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: thread closed; job rb-1722468013-1 finished at 1722468120.
